title: Siguran build i skeniranje slika
summary: Siguran build kontejnera (hadolint, multi-stage, distroless, non-root, digest) i Trivy gate nad slikom: pragovi ozbiljnosti, ranjivosti bez popravke, .trivyignore i VEX.
summary_en: Secure container builds (hadolint, multi-stage, distroless, non-root, digest) and a Trivy gate on the image: severity thresholds, unfixed vulnerabilities, .trivyignore and VEX.
